address: 4 Soi Somkid, Phloen Chit Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: Set in the historical Nai Lert Park Heritage Home, Ma Maison continues a legacy of authentic Thai cuisine. It is rooted in the culinary passion of Nai Lert's wife, Khun Ying Sinn, inspired by her meticulous recipes. The menu features classic Thai dishes with contemporary touches, using fresh ingredients such as freshly squeezed coconut milk. Housed in a modern glass pavilion amid lush century-old gardens, begin your meal with Mu Sarong, a traditional Thai appetiser, followed by authentic Thai dishes that perfectly blend contemporary elements....
